application.title: Rezone Petition Recommendation - 7306 Springfield Ave (Joy Property)

resolutions.summary: Following lengthy discussion with the applicant and their counsel, the Planning Commission was not ready to make a recommendation and asked the applicant to return in December. The Commission expressed a preference for modifying the B-L zone to add automobile service garages as a conditional use rather than a full rezone, and asked staff to provide additional information for the December meeting.

application.title: Rezone Petition Recommendation- 7306 Springfield Ave. (Joy Property)

resolutions.summary: Following a lengthy discussion with the applicant and their counsel about the possibilities of rezoning the property to B-G and modifying the B-L zone to allow an automobile service garage as a conditional use, the Planning Commission agreed it was not ready to make a recommendation to the Mayor and Town Council. The Commission asked the applicant to return in December for further discussion. The Commission expressed a preference toward modifying the B-L zone rather than rezoning the property and asked staff to provide additional information for the December meeting.
